newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Swiss Bank Corp purchase of Asiana stake approved.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Bank Corp purchase of Asiana stake approved.

text.p: The South Korean government on Wednesday approved an application by Swiss Bank Corp's Malaysia-based investment arm, Pacific Investment Capital Ltd, to purchase a 19.02 percent stake in Asiana Airlines for $80 million.

Asiana is issuing 23.4 million new shares to raise its share capital to 70 million shares, and the Swiss Bank Corp unit will take up 13.32 million of the new shares for 5,000 won per share, a Construction and Transportation Ministry official said.

South Korea limits foreign ownership in an airline company at 20 percent or less, and foreign investment in the airline business is required to receive prior approval from the government, the official said.
The Kumho group holds a 77.5 percent stake in Asiana, one of South Korea's two international airliners. Tyre maker Kumho & Co Ltd is the flagship unit of the Kumho group.
Under the old share structure, state-owned Korea Development Bank was the second-biggest shareholder of Asiana with a 17.6 percent stake, an Asiana spokesman said.
He did not give stakes of the two big shareholders in the enlarged capital.
Payment for the capital increase is due to be completed by December 20, he added.
